name: Chlorophyll Dental Bones for Medium Breeds
label: Mint, 70 g

texts.about_this_item: Zubochistiki mint dental bones for medium-breed dogs from 10 kg (4 pieces). Among the best tooth-cleaning treats: they remove plaque well, prevent tartar and fight gum disease; the patented structure makes cleaning as effective as mechanical brushing. 100% natural product; a substantial calcium content strengthens bones and teeth. Enriched with chlorophyll to support digestion.
